name: Methyldesorphine
summary: Methyldesorphine is an opioid analgesic. First synthesized in Germany in 1940 and patented in the US in 1952, it has a high potential for abuse as with any potent opioid agonist, and is sometimes found along with desomorphine as a component of the home-made opioid mixture known as "Krokodil" used in Russia and the neighboring former Soviet republics.

pharmacology.text: First synthesized in Germany in 1940 and patented in the US in 1952, it has a high potential for abuse as with any potent opioid agonist, and is sometimes found along with desomorphine as a component of the home-made opioid mixture known as "Krokodil" used in Russia and the neighboring former Soviet republics.

uses.text: First synthesized in Germany in 1940 and patented in the US in 1952, it has a high potential for abuse as with any potent opioid agonist, and is sometimes found along with desomorphine as a component of the home-made opioid mixture known as "Krokodil" used in Russia and the neighboring former Soviet republics.

sideEffects.en: Like other potent opioids, it carries a high risk of dependence and can slow or stop breathing, which can be fatal. Homemade mixtures containing it, such as krokodil, are linked to severe skin and tissue damage from contaminants.
sideEffects.zh: 和其他強效鴉片類一樣，它有很高的依賴風險，並可能使呼吸減慢甚至停止而致命。含有它的自製混合物如「鱷魚」，因雜質而與嚴重的皮膚與組織損傷有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 和其他强效鸦片类一样，它有很高的依赖风险，并可能使呼吸减慢甚至停止而致命。含有它的自制混合物如「鳄鱼」，因杂质而与严重的皮肤与组织损伤有关。

fact.en: First made in Germany in 1940, methyldesorphine is desomorphine with an extra methyl group, and it has turned up alongside desomorphine in krokodil, a crude homemade opioid.
fact.zh: Methyldesorphine 在1940年於德國首次合成，是在去氧嗎啡上多加一個甲基，曾與去氧嗎啡一起出現在粗製的自製鴉片類「鱷魚」（krokodil）中。
fact.zhHans: Methyldesorphine 在1940年于德国首次合成，是在去氧吗啡上多加一个甲基，曾与去氧吗啡一起出现在粗制的自制鸦片类「鳄鱼」（krokodil）中。
